disposition_reason: Supports measured gallium levels in wild plants and soil and the low soil-to-plant transfer. Wild grasses are not food crops, so it does not support dietary intake estimates.
disposition_locator: Table 1; Table 1; Results, p. 3; Results, p. 3; secondary

study.method: Plants and soil were sampled every 5 h from 9:00 to 19:00, digested in nitric acid and analyzed by ICP-MS. Accuracy was checked with two certified plant reference materials, with differences under 10%.
study.site_context: rhizosphere soil; couch grass; plantain; dandelion

regulatory_or_exposure: Site 1 soil 6.55 to 7.32 mg/kg; roots 0.46 to 1.52 mg/kg; leaves 0.058 to 0.14 mg/kg (Table 1)
